grammar.title: 给出明确的回答
lines: So much is certain: that we would have doctors and preachers, lawyers and defendants, marriages and births -- but our spiritual outlook would be different. So much is certain: that... 如此确定的是…（同位语的固定句式） spiritual outlook 精神面貌/精神视野 We would lay less stress on 'facts and figures' and more on a good memory, on applied psychology, and on the capacity of a man to get along with his fellow-citizens. We would lay less stress on 'facts and figures' and (lay) more (stress) on a good memory, (lay more stress) on applied psychology, and (lay more stress) on the capacity of a man to get along with his fellow-citizens. 课文补全 lay stress on... 强调/重视 get along with... 与…和睦相处 If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past we would have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable. fashion v.（尤指用手工）制作，使成形；塑造 fashioned ... after... 仿照…制作/设计 able / able 前后都可以修饰（灵活性高） 被修饰的词前面有其它修饰时，able / ible 通常会后置。 Among tribal people all knowledge inherited by tradition is shared by all; it is taught to every member of the tribe so that in this respect everybody is equally equipped for life. share v.共享，合用；分享 in this respect 在这一方面;在这点上 equality in terms of receiving knowledge 总结：在获取知识方面的平等性 be equipped for... 为…做好准备/具备…能力
So much is certain: that the project will not be finished on time.如此确定的是：该项目将无法按时完成。
Our spiritual outlook would be different in a bookless world.在一个没有书本的世界里，我们的精神面貌将有所不同。
Meditation can profoundly change a person's spiritual outlook.冥想可以深刻地改变一个人的精神面貌。

It has been said that everyone lives by selling something. In the light of this statement, teachers live by selling knowledge, philosophers (live) by selling wisdom and priests (live) by selling spiritual comfort.

Carlyle was entirely ignorant of what the bottle in his pocket contained, (Carlyle was entirely ignorant) of the nature of the illness from which his friend was suffering, and (Carlyle was entirely ignorant) of what had previously been wrong with his wife, but a medicine …

For in a university, science majors look down on humanities majors, foreign language majors (look down) on Chinese majors, Chinese majors (look down) on philosophy majors, philosophy majors (look down) on sociology majors, and sociology majors (look down) on eattach importance to … ducation majors. Since education majors have no one to look down on, they can only despise the professors in their own department. 《围城》
The company lays great stress on customer service.该公司非常重视客户服务。
We would lay less stress on 'facts and figures' and more on a good memory.我们对“事实和数据”的重视会减少，而对良好的记忆力会更加重视。

attach importance to … 重视 We would attach less importance to 'facts and figures' and more to a good memory, to applied psychology, and to the capacity of a man to get along with his fellow-citizens. 课文改写
It is important to get along with your colleagues.与同事和睦相处很重要。
He has the capacity to get along with his fellow-citizens.他有与同胞和睦相处的能力。
Despite their differences, the two neighbours get along well.尽管他们之间有分歧，但这两个邻居相处得很好。
He fashioned a toy gun from a piece of wood.
She fashioned a pot from the clay. 她用黏土制成一个罐。
He fashioned a whistle out of a piece of wood. 他用一块木头做成一个哨子。
He fashioned a box from some old pieces of wood. 他用几块旧木板手工做了一个盒子。
If you fashion your character after your brother’s, you’ll get along with your classmates. 按照后者改变前者
The new building is fashioned after an old Roman temple.这座新建筑是仿照一座古罗马神庙设计的。
Her new dress was fashioned after a latest style. 她的新衣服是根据一种最新款式制作的。
Mary has always fashioned herself after her mother. 玛丽总模仿她的母亲。
He has to deduce what he can from the few scanty clues available .
the most civilized society imaginable
the most shocking spectacle conceivable
the most effectual measure possible
the most talented person available
In some moods, nature shares it. 有一样的，共同的
This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to make sure that all our children could share in the knowledge accumulated by the 'happy few' during the past centuries. 本课内容
share sth. with sb. 与某人分享某物 I would like to share my ideas with the rest of the team. 我想与团队的其他成员分享我的想法。
share (in) sth. 分享/分担（情感、责任、成果等） We all share in the joy of your great success. 我们都分享着你获得巨大成功的喜悦。 She shares (in) my troubles as well as my joys.
The two companies are similar in this respect: both prioritize innovation.这两家公司在这一方面是相似的：都优先考虑创新。
The two models are very similar in this respect. 这两款型号在这方面非常相似。
in this aspect 在这个方面 We need to improve our service in this aspect. 我们需要在这个方面改进我们的服务。
in this way 以这种方式；这样一来 In this way, we can save both time and money. 以这种方式，我们既能节省时间又能省钱。
from this angle 从这个角度（物理或抽象） If you look at the problem from this angle, it seems much simpler. 如果你从这个角度看问题，它似乎简单得多。
from this perspective 从这个视角/观点来看 From this perspective, the decision was clearly the right one. 从这个视角来看，那个决定显然是正确的。
The training program aims to ensure that all graduates are equipped for the challenges of the modern workplace.该培训计划旨在确保所有毕业生为现代工作场所的挑战做好准备。
The centre is well equipped for canoeing and mountaineering. 本中心有齐全的划船和登山设备。
Is the ship fully equipped for its voyage? 这条船已经为出航装备好了吗？
This hotel room is not equipped for cooking. 这家旅馆的房间不备炊具。

sentences.title: 承上启下
lines: It is the ideal condition of the 'equal start' which only our most progressive forms of modern education try to regain . pro gres sive adj.进步的、先进的 regain v.recover / restore 重新获得，恢复；重回，回到（某处） In primitive cultures the obligation to seek and to receive the traditional instruction is binding to all. obligation to do sth. 做某事的义务/责任 binding adj.(协议，承诺）有约束力的，必须遵守的 There are no 'illiterates' -- if the term can be applied to peoples without a script -- while our own compulsory school attendance became law in Germany in 1642, in France in 1806, and in England in 1876, and is still non-existent in a number of 'civilized' nations. script n.文字；脚本；剧本 compulsory school attendance / education / schooling 义务教育 This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to make sure that all our children could share in the knowledge accumulated by the 'happy few' during the past centuries. before conj. （先）…才…;就...；然后...;宁愿..也不... the few （有权有势的）少数人 The 19th Amendment to the Constitution of the US shows how long it was before the Americans deemed it necessary to make sure that women could share in the right to vote taken by the privileged few during the past few centuries. 阅读资料
The progressive political party campaigned for more environmental protections. 该进步政党致力于争取更多的环境保护措施。
Her progressive ideas about education reform were well-received by the board. 她关于教育改革的进步思想受到了委员会的好评。
ag gres sive 好斗的；进取的；有侵略性的 The company took an aggressive approach to capturing the new market. 该公司采取了积极进取的方式来占领新市场。
re gres sive 退步的；退化的；（税收）倒退的 Critics argue that the new tax is regressive and hurts the poor. 批评者认为新税收制度是倒退的，会伤害穷人。
It took him several months to fully regain / recover / restore his health after the surgery. 手术后他花了几个月时间才完全恢复健康。
The patient was overjoyed to regain / recover / restore her sight after the successful operation. 手术成功后，病人因恢复视力而欣喜若狂。
The doctors worked quickly to regain / recover / restore his consciousness after he fainted. 他晕倒后，医生们迅速采取行动使他恢复了知觉。
She tripped on the rug but managed to regain / recover / restore her balance before falling. 她在地毯上绊了一一下，但在摔倒前稳住了平衡。
He took a deep breath to regain / recover / restore his composure before starting the speech. 在开始演讲前，他深吸了一口气以恢复镇静。
American business will regain / recover / restore its shine.美国商业将重获光彩。
Employees have an obligation to follow the company's code of conduct.员工有义务遵守公司的行为准则。
We have a moral obligation to protect the environment. 我们有道义责任保护环境。
She did not feel under any obligation to tell him the truth. 她觉得没有义务告诉他实情。
We do not have any legal or moral obligation to any physician. 我们对任何医生都没有任何法律或道义上的义务。
The firm has no obligation / is under no obligation / isn’t under any obligation to offer you a job.
have an obligation to do sth. 有义务做某事 Parents have an obligation to ensure their children receive an education. 父母有义务确保孩子接受教育。
be under an obligation to do sth. 承担做某事的义务 The company is under an obligation to provide a safe working environment. 公司有义务提供安全的工作环境。
have no obligation to do sth. 没有义务做某事 You have no obligation to answer any personal questions during the interview. 在面试中，你没有义务回答任何私人问题。
be under no obligation to do sth. 不承担做某事的义务 The shop is under no obligation to offer a refund without a receipt. 如果没有收据，商店没有义务提供退款。
be not under any obligation to do sth. （强调）不承担任何做某事的义务 We are not under any obligation to accept the first offer we receive. 我们没有任何义务必须接受我们收到的第一份报价。
a legally binding document
...proposals for a legally binding commitment on nations to stabilize emissions of carbon dioxide. …关于就稳定二氧化碳排放各国做出有法律约束力的承诺的建议。
Once both parties sign the document, it becomes a legally binding agreement. 一旦双方签署文件，它就成了具有法律约束力的协议。
bind v.约束(bound )捆绑；约束；使团结 The thief is bound to a tree. Common interests bind the different members of the community together. 共同的利益将社区的不同成员团结在一起。
bind sb. to do sth. 约束某人做某事 The terms of the contract bind him to complete the work by June. 合同条款约束他必须在六月前完成工作。 The Kyoto Protocol binds each country to reduce the emission of greenhouse gases.
be binding to all 对所有人都有约束力 The contract terms are binding to all parties involved.合同条款对所有相关方都具有约束力。 The law is binding to all citizens.法律对所有公民都有约束力。
The ancient script was finally deciphered by a team of archaeologists. 这套古文字最终被一支考古队破译了。
Many different languages in history have been written using Arab script. 历史上许多不同的语言都曾使用阿拉伯文字书写。
The state enforces compulsory school attendance for all children under sixteen. 州政府对所有 16 岁以下的儿童强制执行就学规定。
Free compulsory education is a fundamental right in many countries. 在许多国家，免费义务教育是一项基本权利。
The age for compulsory schooling varies depending on local laws. 义务教育的年龄因当地法律而异。
It will be a long time before we meet again. 时间比预期的长，翻译为“才...”
Looking at his watch, he saw that it was one o'clock, but the bell struck thirteen times before it stopped . 才...
I hadn’t waited long before he came. 比预期的时间短，翻译为“就...”
I shaved before I went to the party. 当成副词，翻译为“然后...”
Alfred stayed in the camp a week before he returned to Athelney . 然后...
I’ll die before I give in. 宁愿也不...“宁死不屈”
…, and these will ply the short wings with such irresistible power that they can bore for long distances through an opposing gale before exhaustion follows. 直到...

when conj. （比预期长）才... The plane had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain. 比预期长，翻译为“才...” He had travelled only seven miles across the Channel when his engine failed and he was forced to land on the sea. 比预期短，翻译为“就...” Shrugging my shoulders, I began to walk away when, a moment later, he ran after me and thrust the pen into my hands. 然后... Stone does not decay, and so the tools of long ago have remained when even the bones of the men who made them have disappeared without trace. 尽管... Why do you walk when you have a car? 既然(引导让步)
A government should serve the many, not the few.
Decisions are often made by the few who control the resources. 决定往往是由掌控资源的少数人做出的。
the minority 少数(民族)人 Such persons are certainly in the minority. 这种人当然占少数。
the happy few 少数幸运儿；少数享有特权的人 Only the happy few were invited to the private gallery opening. 只有少数幸运儿被邀请参加私人画廊的开幕式。
the privileged few 少数特权阶层 Quality healthcare should not be reserved only for the privileged few. 优质的医疗保健不应仅供少数特权阶层享有。
the many 大众；多数人 Laws should be designed to benefit the many, not just the powerful. 法律的设计应当造福大众，而不仅仅是权势者。
the majority 大多数 The majority of the time, I brown-bagged my lunch. 大多数时间，我都是自带午餐。

expand.title: 总结（借古讽今）
lines: Education in the wilderness is not a matter of monetary means. a / the matter / question of … …的事儿/问题 monetary means 金钱手段/经济能力 All are entitled to an equal start. All are entitled to receive equal education. 替换写法 be entitled to 有资格享有/有权获得 There is none of the hurry which, in our society, often hampers the full development of a growing personality . hamper v.妨碍/阻碍 There, a child grows up under the ever-present attention of his parent; therefore the jungles and the savannahs know of no 'juvenile delinquency'. ever-present attention 无时不在的关注(始终在场的、从未缺席的) ever-doing 始终、一直、持续... jungle (经常出现在固定搭配中)n.（热带）丛林；弱肉强食的地方 know of no... 不知道有…/没有… sth. know of 托物抒情(无灵主语) No necessity of making a living away from home results in neglect of children, and no father is confronted with his inability to 'buy' an education for his child. No 位于句首，否定整句话 be confronted / faced with … 面对/遭遇（通常指必须处理的困难或问题）
It’s only a matter of time.
It’s a matter of personal taste.
It’s a matter of preference.
It’s a matter of interest.
It’s a matter of life and death.
I can’t take the money. It’s a matter of principle.
… it looks very much as if sleeping is not simply a matter of giving the body a rest .
These are partly a matter of personal circumstances, partly a matter of psychology .

a question of ... ...的问题 She is so talented that her success is only a question of time. … but as soon as the question of prestige arises, … Refusing to ask for help was a question of pride for him. 对他来说，拒绝寻求帮助是一个自尊心问题。
Education in the wilderness is not a matter of monetary means.荒野中的教育不是金钱的问题。
The project failed due to a lack of monetary means.由于缺乏经济能力，该项目失败了。
The charity relies on donations rather than its own monetary means.该慈善机构依靠捐款，而不是自身的经济能力。
monetary policy 货币政策 The central bank adjusted its monetary policy to control inflation. 中央银行调整了其货币政策以控制通货膨胀。
monetary unit 货币单位 The dollar is the basic monetary unit of the United States. 美元是美国的基本货币单位。
Everyone is entitled to an equal start in the primitive education system.在原始教育体系中，所有人都有权享有平等的起跑线。
All citizens are entitled to free healthcare.所有公民都有权获得免费医疗。
You may be entitled to a refund if the product is faulty.如果产品有缺陷，您可能有权获得退款
be entitled to sth. 有权获得某物；有权享有某事 Full-time employees are entitled to annual paid leave. 全职员工有权享有年度带薪休假。
be entitled to do sth. 有权做某事 You are entitled to receive a discount if you book in advance. 如果你提前预订，就有权获得折扣。
Lack of experience may hamper his progress.缺乏经验可能会妨碍他的进步。

The author contrasts the slow, careful pace of wilderness education with the hurry which, in our society, often hampers the full development of a growing personality.作者将荒野教育缓慢、谨慎的节奏与“在我们社会中经常妨碍成长中人格充分发展的仓促”进行了对比。
Bad weather will hamper rescue efforts.恶劣的天气将阻碍救援工作。
the ever-present threat 始终存在的威胁
The child grows up under the ever-present attention of his parent.孩子在父母无时不在的关注下成长。
The problem of climate change is an ever-present concern for scientists.气候变化问题是科学家们一直关注的问题。
We have to ask ourselves very seriously what will happen if this twofold use of knowledge, with its ever-increasing power, continues.
Companies with a lot of this type of debt are in a big hurry, willing to trade ever-decreasing velocity for expediency of delivery. 公司有很多此类债务，他们很着急，愿意用交付换取逐渐降低的速度。
We need things consumed, burned up, replaced and discarded at an ever-accelerating rate. 我们需要以一直在加快的速率，消费、燃烧、更换和抛弃东西。
the ever-changing world 不断变化的世界 We must adapt quickly to succeed in the ever-changing world. 我们必须快速适应才能在这个不断变化的世界中取得成功。
the ever-growing knowledge 不断增长的知识 Lifelong learning is essential to keep up with the ever-growing knowledge of the digital age. 终身学习对于紧跟信息时代不断增长的知识至关重要。
the ever-developing economy 不断发展的经济 New job opportunities are created by the ever-developing economy. 不断发展的经济创造了新的就业机会。
the ever-expanding market 不断扩大的市场 The company is looking for ways to enter the ever-expanding market in Southeast Asia. 公司正在寻找进入东南亚这一不断扩大的市场的方法。
the ever-deepening reform 不断深化的改革 The ever-deepening reform has brought significant changes to the education system. 不断深化的改革给教育体制带来了重大变化。
the ever-dwindling resources 不断减少的资源 We must find sustainable alternatives to replace the ever-dwindling resources of fossil fuels. 我们必须找到可持续的替代品来取代不断减少的化石燃料资源。
After years of living in the concrete jungle of New York, he moved to a quiet farm. 在纽约这个水泥丛林（指拥挤、冷漠且充满竞争的大城市）生活了多年后，他搬到了一个安静的农场。
In the cutthroat world of international business, the law of the jungle often prevails. 在残酷的国际商业世界中，丛林法则（指弱肉强食、适者生存）往往占据主导地位。
The jungles and the savannahs know of no 'juvenile delinquency'.丛林和稀树草原不知道有“青少年犯罪”。
The peaceful village knows of no violence.这个和平的村庄不知道有暴力。
Verrazano, an Italian about whom little is known, sailed into New York Harbour in 1524 and named it Angouleme.
The 1980s witnessed enormous growth in the financial sector. 80年代见证了...
A gentle breeze caressed my cheeks and soothed my heart. 轻风拂面、抚慰我心~
know of / about 知道；了解（关于……的情况） I know of the artist, but I don't know much about her specific style. 我知道这位艺术家，但对她的具体风格了解不多。
learn of / about 获悉；得知；了解 We were shocked to learn of the sudden changes to the project. 获悉项目的突然变动，我们感到非常震惊。
hear of / about 听说；得知 Have you heard of the new restaurant that opened downtown? 你听说过市中心新开的那家餐厅吗？
No money buys health. 钱买不到健康
No two sorts of birds practise quite the same sort of flight; the varieties are infinite; but two classes may be roughly seen.
The government was confronted with a severe economic crisis. 政府面临着严重的经济危机。
No father is confronted with his inability to 'buy' an education for his child.没有父亲会面对他无法为孩子“购买”教育的问题。
The government is confronted with the challenge of rising unemployment.政府正面临失业率上升的挑战。
He was suddenly confronted with the truth.他突然面对了真相。
be faced with ... 面对；面临（处境、选择或障碍） We are faced with a difficult choice between two excellent candidates. 我们正面临在两位优秀候选人之间做出艰难的选择。
